$comment: Hand-maintained: Equicord plugins Qord should port next, most useful and popular first. 'effort' is small, medium or large; 'goodFirst' marks plugins the existing plugin API already covers, so a first contribution needs no client changes; 'needs' says what is missing in Qord. Plugins that reach Tested drop out of the generated lists by themselves. Rendered into README.md and docs/roadmap.md by tools/check_equicord_plugins.py --write-docs.

plugins.name: GameActivityToggle
plugins.needs: Buttons in the user panel; Discord's synced "share your activity" setting and Spotify's per-account sharing.

plugins.name: BetterSessions
plugins.needs: A Devices page in settings listing your sessions (GET /auth/sessions), with names and log out.

plugins.name: ReviewDB
plugins.needs: Reviews on profiles from the ReviewDB service: its OAuth login, a profile section, and writing reviews.

plugins.name: RelationshipNotifier
plugins.needs: Relationship and server-removal events reaching plugins (plugin notifications exist).

plugins.name: BlockKeywords
plugins.needs: Nothing new: the messageFilter hook hides messages matching your keywords or regexes.

plugins.name: FollowVoiceUser
plugins.needs: Nothing new: "Follow" in the user menu (userContextMenu), then join where they go (voiceStates hook, UiService::joinVoiceChannel).

plugins.name: CopyEmojiMarkdown
plugins.needs: Nothing new for the emoji picker's menu (emojiSuggestions hook); messages' emojis have no menu yet.

plugins.name: ServerListIndicators
plugins.needs: Friends' online status for plugins; the server list button (serverListButtons hook) already exists.

plugins.name: PreviewMessage
plugins.needs: The message box's text in ChatContext, so a chat bar button can preview it.

plugins.name: DecodeBase64
plugins.needs: Nothing new: "Decode Base64" in the message menu (messageContextMenu) showing the decoded text (UiService::showTextDialog).

plugins.name: UnitConverter
plugins.needs: Nothing new: "Convert Units" in the message menu (messageContextMenu), shown under the message (messageAccessories).

plugins.name: KeywordNotify
plugins.needs: Messages matching keywords reaching plugins as notifications (UiService::showNotification exists), and a mentions-inbox tab for them.

plugins.name: MessageLinkTooltip
plugins.needs: Hover tooltips on message links showing the linked message (the fetch_messages service exists).

plugins.name: ReplyTimestamp
plugins.needs: A hook for the reply line above a message, to show when the replied message was sent.

plugins.name: CharacterCounter
plugins.needs: A way for plugins to show text next to the message box as you type.

plugins.name: ShowTimeoutDuration
plugins.needs: Discord's timeout icon next to timed-out members, which plugins can then label with the time left.

plugins.name: VoiceChannelLog
plugins.needs: A log view of who joined and left a voice channel (the voiceStates hook exists).

plugins.name: Timezones
plugins.needs: Per-user time zones, shown next to message timestamps and in profiles.

plugins.name: PictureInPicture
plugins.needs: Pop-out playback for video attachments.

plugins.name: NoPendingCount
plugins.needs: A display option to hide the pending request count on the Friends page and home icon.

plugins.name: VoiceChatDoubleClick
plugins.needs: A display option so voice channels join on double click instead of single click.

plugins.name: ClickableRoles
plugins.needs: Clicks on profile roles reaching plugins (the profileRoleButtons hook is close).

plugins.name: MoreQuickReactions
plugins.needs: Plugin control over how many reactions the hover bar offers.

plugins.name: MentionAvatars
plugins.needs: Avatars inside user mentions when rendering messages.

plugins.name: LastActive
plugins.needs: A user menu item that searches for their last message (search API).

plugins.name: StreamerModeOn
plugins.needs: A streamer mode in the client (hides personal information) that plugins can switch.

plugins.name: CustomIdle
plugins.needs: Plugin control over when the client sets you idle.

plugins.name: UnreadCountBadge
plugins.needs: Unread counts on channels in the channel list (a display option).

plugins.name: NoTypingAnimation
plugins.needs: A display option to stop the typing indicator's dots animating.

plugins.name: SilenceUsers
plugins.needs: Per-user silencing of notifications and sounds (the notifications hook exists).
